summary: End-to-end testing of Attendance & Salary feature. 12/12 backend pytest cases pass (security 403s, dashboard KPIs, admin edit with correct status derivation present→late/half-day, activity logs with 'old → new' detail, salary math per_day=monthly/days and net=earned+bonus-advance, mark paid toggle, xlsx/csv/pdf exports and salary slip). Frontend: employee login OK, 'My Attendance' sidebar nav + emp-attendance-tile present, /employee/attendance renders att-today-card, live clock, monthly summary KPIs (1 present, 0 absent, 1 late, 2 half_day, 1 paid_leave, 0 unpaid_leave), 5 att-row entries. 'Day complete' state shown since checkout already done. Admin login OK, dashboard shows all 8 att-kpi-* KPIs (Total 1, Present 1, Absent 0, Late 1, OnLeave 0, Monthly ₹15,000, Paid ₹0, Pending ₹1,435.48). attendance-summary-link navigates to /admin/attendance. Attendance tab: filters/exports/edit all working — edit of 2026-10-03 to present 10:00-13:00 produced 'Half Day' pill as expected (3h<4). Salary tab: sal-month, sal-rows, sal-net-*, sal-edit-*, sal-pay-* (Mark Paid), sal-slip-*, sal-export-* all present and functional (Set/Adjust saved → toast). Regression: customer login + bonus-wallet-card visible on dashboard. Employee navigating to /admin/attendance correctly redirects back to /employee.

issues: Console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — status filter <select> option labels appear to render with inline icon/span causing React hydration warning. Non-blocking but should be cleaned (plain text in <option> only).

action_items: (Optional) Fix hydration warning in AttendanceTab status <select>: ensure <option> children are plain strings (no <span>/<svg>). Currently only labels are rendered but the warning fires — verify STATUS_META values don't contain JSX.
critical_code_review_comments: attendance_routes.py:235 uses `datetime.fromisoformat(date).replace(..., tzinfo=IST)` — works since date is just 'YYYY-MM-DD' but relies on IST being a fixed-offset tz (OK here with timedelta(5:30)).
In salary payment toggle UI (SalaryTab.pay), reusing existing bonus/advance/etc. on toggle is good — prevents accidental resets.

AttendanceTab filter select for status includes 'All statuses' option but no 'Virtual' indicator for synthesized absent rows (date mode) — fine as rows are tagged by status; edit button still works and upserts a real record.
No input validation on sal-monthly_salary negative values client-side (backend rejects <0 with 400). Could add min=0 attribute (already present).
